content.text: What You Can Actually Get Done Today

You can set up a digital storefront today using the Sovereign Starter Stack. With GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you eliminate reliance on traditional payment processors. Start by creating a GitHub account, then deploy your store in 48 hours. This stack allows you to manage up to three products, supporting payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. Instant product delivery and full data ownership mean you are in complete control from day one.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Sovereign Starter Stack is your go-to solution. For just $97, you gain access to a fully operational online store that processes crypto payments efficiently. Integrate GitHub Pages for hosting, leverage Google Apps Script for backend logic, and use NOWPayments for handling transactions. This setup requires no subscriptions and provides you with lifetime access, ensuring that you retain ownership of your business without the threat of financial isolation.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

Focus on the key infrastructure components first. You don’t need to worry about advanced marketing strategies or complicated payment systems when starting. Instead, prioritize setting up your store and integrating a reliable crypto payment method. Once your store is live and generating sales, you can then explore additional marketing and scaling strategies. This approach keeps you agile and focused on immediate revenue generation.
Blockchain payments eliminate geographic barriers for digital creators.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

To initiate your first transaction, upload your digital products to your GitHub Pages store and set up your NOWPayments account. Ensure that you have selected cryptocurrencies that settle quickly and at low fees, such as USDT on the Tron network, which can finalize transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee of less than $0.10. Promote your store through social media or local channels, and watch your sales begin to flow.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

In the next 24 hours, complete the following steps: Create a GitHub account and set up your store using the Sovereign Starter Stack. Load three digital products and configure NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. Promote your store through local networks, and consider joining Binance P2P to facilitate consumer transactions using local currencies like naira or cedis. By the end of this period, you will have a functional store ready for sales.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Creators in Africa can sell digital products to international buyers by leveraging blockchain payments and decentralized infrastructure. By deploying tools like the Sovereign Starter Stack, you can set up a fully operational online store that accepts cryptocurrency payments without relying on platforms like Stripe. With this approach, you maintain full control over your business and financial transactions.
Instant product delivery and full data ownership empower your business.

Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
